why: Issue #3 character expression sheets: the states the cast cards don't cover yet. Cordula's paddle-vault and paddle-drum (canon gear line: the paddle is a vaulting pole, a doorstop, a drum, a color-guard staff); Barnaby's plotting, irritated and academic chromatophore states (calm=base and stealth already ship); Chonks Spine Flare and Shelly Saltwater Jet (both canon abilities with no card); Off-Beat dance-off versions of the four bosses (every standard opponent already has one).

renders.name: card-cast-cordula-vault
renders.subject: {CORDULA} mid vault over a flooded dungeon gap, both hands on her black touring paddle planted like a pole-vault pole, body extended horizontal above churning water, karambit sheaths visible on her calves, fierce joyful grin, athletic peak moment

place.where: Cordula section, beside the Gear line about the paddle as a vaulting pole
place.alt: Cordula vaulting over floodwater on her planted black paddle like a pole-vaulter, body extended mid-air

renders.name: card-cast-cordula-drum
renders.subject: {CORDULA} drumming the Final Beat with her black touring paddle on the taut skin of a huge barnacled harbour buoy used as a war drum, mid-strike, water spraying off the buoy skin, metronome-steady face, the drummer who never misses a count

place.where: Cordula section, beside the Final Beat line
place.alt: Cordula drumming the Final Beat with her paddle on a barnacled buoy repurposed as a war drum

renders.name: card-cast-barnaby-plotting
renders.subject: {BARNABY} plotting: two arm-tips steepled together under his gaze like a schemer's fingers, one eye half-lidded and narrowed, the other arms coiled in neat thoughtful loops, faint violet collar glow, the look of an octopus three moves ahead

place.where: Barnaby section, expression sheet row, plotting
place.alt: Barnaby plotting with arm-tips steepled and one eye narrowed, collar glowing faint violet

renders.name: card-cast-barnaby-irritated
renders.subject: {BARNABY} irritated: arms folded in a crossed knot, skin mottled with the first red blush of temper over the charcoal, one eye fixed on the viewer with a flat stare, collar glow burning brighter violet, deeply unimpressed

place.where: Barnaby section, expression sheet row, irritated
place.alt: Barnaby irritated with arms knotted and skin blushing red over charcoal, collar glowing hot

renders.name: card-cast-barnaby-academic
renders.subject: {BARNABY} the academic: studying a huge open waterproof handbook held in two arms, one arm-tip turning the page, another arm holding a pencil stub, eyes intent, collar glowing a steady scholarly violet, the Ph.D.-level escape artist at work

place.where: Barnaby section, expression sheet row, academic
place.alt: Barnaby studying an open waterproof handbook, one arm turning the page, collar glowing steady violet

renders.name: card-cast-chonks-flare
renders.subject: {LUMPSUCKER} performing his Spine Flare: puffed up twice as round while suction-latched onto a brass ship's-wheel spoke, every spine erect and bristling, eyes squeezed to furious slits, daring anyone to grab him, comically defiant

place.where: Chonks section, beside the Spine Flare ability
place.alt: Chonks puffed round with every spine erect while latched to a brass wheel spoke, eyes squeezed shut

renders.name: card-cast-shelly-jet
renders.subject: Shelly the geoduck firing his Saltwater Jet: {GEODUCK} braced in cracked stone, a high-pressure fan of seawater blasting sideways from the siphon tip and shoving back a tumbling wave of mud and grit, the carabiner glinting on his shell ring, immovable artillery

place.where: Shelly section, beside the Saltwater Jet ability
place.alt: Shelly braced in stone, firing a high-pressure fan of seawater from his siphon, mud tumbling back

renders.subject: Monty the giant python Off-Beat: a huge python tied in a knot trying to follow the choreography, head bobbing a half-beat late, tongue out in concentration, stage lights glaring, trying so hard and failing

place.where: floor boss card, after the Had Monty danced off-beat line
